article_title: Scalable AI-based clinical communication training and automated assessment
citation: Masum Hasan, Ron Epstein, Thomas Carroll, Ehsan Hoque. (2026). Scalable AI-based clinical communication training and automated assessment. https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22517
title: The 3E framework: Empower, Be Explicit, and Empathize as measurable dimensions of clinical communication
description: The 3E framework, drawn from the MVP (medical situation, values, and plan) model for serious illness conversations, defines three communication skills—Empower, Be Explicit, and Empathize—that the article treats as quantifiable dimensions of clinical communication. Scores are calculated with a Likert questionnaire, and both trained standardized-patient raters and the automated LLM judge apply the same rubric to transcripts. The framework serves as the platform's primary performance outcome and its domain-level outcomes, and structures the personalized feedback learners receive after each encounter.
requirements: A structured rubric and rating instructions, applied consistently by human or automated raters, to produce comparable Likert scores
constraints: Agreement was relatively weaker for the Be Explicit dimension for all LLM judges, for reasons the authors state remain unknown
examples: Post-training self-ratings across the three domains ranged 3.75–4.08 out of 5, with Empathize rated highest
